use_case_summary: Low-latency chat for trading desk + embeddings for search/ranking. Require sub-80ms p50 generation, p95 < 220ms for 512-token context on peak. Need throughput guarantees for 6k concurrent inference QPS across regions; expected sustained 2k QPS/region with 3x failover headroom.
requirements_details: Reserved GPU pool sizing: target 48x A100-80GB equiv per region (us-east1/us-west1/eu-central1) with 30% headroom for AZ failover
Latency SLOs: p50 <80ms, p95 <220ms (512 tokens), cold-start target <300ms
Throughput guarantees: 6k QPS aggregate, 2k sustained per region with auto-burst to 3k for 3 min
Failover plan: cross-region routing with warm standby pools; target failover window < 60s
SLA negotiation points: credits for degraded p95 beyond 5% monthly floor, clear definition of 'downtime' for containers vs network
Routing policy: prefer local region, fallback to regional compatible model variants; deterministic routing for PCI workflows
Data controls: keys in customer KMS, audit logs retained 1 year, option to pin model versions
Network/cost: clarify cross-region egress caps and billing during failover
Operational: canary rollout plan, canary size 5% traffic for 24h, rollback safepoints
POC tests: sustained 2-hour soak at 2k QPS/region + single-AZ kill to validate failover headroom
